info.title: Positioning Ingestion API
info.description: Backend API contract for Android client to ingest connection and patrol session events for positioning data.

post.description: Sent when Android connects to a beacon.

201.description: Connection event recorded successfully. The body returns the stored event and resolves the beacon to its patrol area, so the client can show where it is without a separate lookup.

post.description: Sent when Android disconnects from a beacon.

201.description: Disconnection event recorded successfully. The acknowledgement is the record's registration: the closed record is now the server's source of truth.

post.description: Sent when user clicks a button in order start patrol session on the Android device.

Sent when user clicks a button in order to stop patrol session on the Android device. The server also closes any open connections for this android_id by appending a disconnect event for every connect event that has no matching disconnect, using this stop timestamp.

beacon_id.description: Beacon UUID the beacon device connected to or disconnected from.

timestamp.description: When the connection or disconnection occurred on the device. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

stored-event.description: An event as stored in the append-only event store. Returned in the 201 acknowledgement so the client knows what the server registered.

event_id.description: Server-generated identifier of the appended event.

event_type.description: The type of event, implied by the endpoint called.

beacon_id.description: Beacon UUID the device connected to or disconnected from.

device_timestamp.description: When the event occurred on the device, as given in the request. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

server_timestamp.description: When the backend recorded the event. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

source.description: Server-assigned origin of the write, e.g. the API route that appended the event. Never taken from the request body.

patrol-area.description: The patrol area a beacon belongs to, resolved by the backend so the client can display a place name instead of a beacon id. Same shape as RecordArea in the patrol-record contract.

area_id.description: Identifier of the patrol area, unique within its station.

name.description: Display name of the area, e.g. 'Frederiksberg platform'.

line.description: The metro line(s) the area serves (e.g. ["M1", "M2"] for an interchange).

station_id.description: Identifier of the station the area belongs to.

area_type.description: Kind of area. Decides how long a visit must last to count as a patrol.

connect-event-stored.description: The stored connect event acknowledgement: the event as registered by the server plus the beacon's area, resolved so the client can display where it is immediately.

area.description: The patrol area the beacon belongs to, resolved by the backend.

timestamp.description: When the connection or disconnection occurred on the device. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for developers
